scope: Development review only. Purpose/fact semantics require independent human review. Literal fact checks measure phrase coverage in the actual stored summary, not entailment or identity verification. Closure means accepted local closing request, never provider completion.

required_facts: Friday at 3 PM retained without a repeated time question
